How Project Based Learning works

01

Big Question

Student are given a real-life question that is meaningful to them Ex: “how can we reduce waste in our school”

02

Explore

Student investigate the topic through; observation, discussion, play- they are encourage to wonder

03

Learn

Teacher introduce key knowledge and skill ( math, english, science, ICT, national curriculum) all taught in connected way

04

Try

Student Apply what they have learn ( practice, experiment, test ideas, improve)

05

Create

Use their knowledge to make something meaningful (poster, model, presentation, etc)--young creators

06

Share

Present work/project to class/teachers/parents to explain what they have learn and why it matter

Project Based Learning Student Personal Development

Cambridge Curriculum

  • Global Perspective

    Foster a broad worldview by incorporating international content and cultural awareness, encouraging students to understand and appreciate diversity.

  • Student-Centered Learning

    Focus on personalized learning approaches, promoting critical thinking and independent inquiry while addressing individual student needs and strengths.

  • Skill Development

    Emphasize the development of core academic skills, including literacy, numeracy, and scientific thinking.

National Curriculum

  • Personalized Learning

    Emphasize student autonomy and flexibility in learning, allowing students to explore their interests and learn at their own pace.

  • Character Building

    Focus on the development of key moral values, including integrity, empathy, and respect, aiming to nurture students’ character and social-emotional well-being.

  • Contextual and Local Content

    Incorporate local wisdom, culture, and community-based learning, connecting students with their heritage and environment while preparing them to be global citizens.

Cultivating the Future Custodians of Our Planet

At Almacita, sustainability is not just a subject—it is a way of life. We empower students to connect classroom knowledge with real-world action through a curriculum designed for lasting impact.

9 sustainability modules

  • Protecting ecosystems

  • Ensuring clean air quality

  • Encouraging sustainable choices

  • Embracing green mobility

Sustainability Approach

Environmental Awareness

Incorporate lessons and activities that raise awareness about environmental issues, promote sustainable practices, and encourage students to take action to protect the planet.

Project-Based Learning

hands-on projects that address real-world sustainability challenges, such as waste reduction, energy conservation, and biodiversity preservation.

Community Engagement

Foster partnerships with local organizations and initiatives that promote sustainability.
